all.name: Sets and counting principles
all.description: Set notation, Venn diagrams, inclusion-exclusion and the rule of product.
objectives: use set notation for union, intersection and complement

all.name: Permutations and combinations
all.description: Counting orderings and subsets to compute probabilities.

all.description: Conditional probability, the multiplication rule, the law of total probability, urns and trees.
objectives: compute conditional probability from the definition
use the law of total probability over a partition

all.name: Independence of events
all.description: Definition and checking of independence and its paradoxes.

all.name: Bayes' theorem and base rate fallacy
all.description: Inverting conditional probabilities with Bayes' theorem, illustrated by screening tests.
objectives: explain the base rate fallacy in diagnostic tests

all.name: Random variables, pmf and cdf
all.description: Random variables as payoff functions with their probability mass and cumulative distribution functions.
objectives: write the pmf of a random variable

all.name: Bernoulli, binomial, geometric distributions

objectives: identify Bernoulli, binomial, geometric and uniform models
add random variables such as indicator sums

all.description: Prior, likelihood, and posterior in a tabular Bayes update with discrete hypotheses.
objectives: identify prior, likelihood, posterior, data and hypotheses
express prior and posterior as pmfs

objectives: update a posterior with new data
use a posterior as the next prior
apply update tables to screening tests
